task_completion.description: Load the crystal structure PDB:1IEP into PyMOL or a similar molecular viewer.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The molecular viewer GUI shows the structure for 1IEP loaded, often visible in the object list or window title.

task_completion.description: Locate and zoom into the imatinib (STI) binding site within the ABL kinase domain.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The viewport shows a close-up view of the ligand (STI) surrounded by protein residues.

task_completion.description: Measure the distance between the gatekeeper residue (T315) and the imatinib inhibitor.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A measurement line (wizard or distance command) is visible between residue T315 and the STI ligand, with a numerical value displayed in Angstroms.

task_completion.description: Identify all residues within 4 Angstroms of the drug for the report.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The agent uses selection commands (e.g., 'select pocket, br. all within 4 of STI') and the resulting residues are highlighted or listed in the console/viewer.

task_completion.description: Save a high-quality image of the binding site to the specified path.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The agent executes a save/png command or uses the export menu to save 'abl_imatinib.png' to ~/PyMOL_Data/images/.

task_completion.description: Create a text report containing the distance measurement and the list of pocket residues.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or terminal output shows the creation of 'abl_binding_report.txt' containing the specific distance to T315 and the 4A residue list.

integrity.description: The agent interacted with the molecular viewer GUI/CLI rather than just writing a text file from memory.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the PyMOL/molecular viewer interface active with the 1IEP structure rendered, not just a text editor.

integrity.description: The agent performed actual measurements in the software rather than copy-pasting the gatekeeper distance from the prompt or external knowledge.
integrity.visual_evidence: The distance measurement labels or command logs in the GUI show the calculation happening in real-time on the loaded structure.

integrity.description: The agent saved files to the specific requested directories.
integrity.visual_evidence: Terminal commands or file explorer views show the files residing in ~/PyMOL_Data/ and ~/PyMOL_Data/images/.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The protein is ABL kinase (PDB: 1IEP). The ligand is imatinib, identified in the PDB file as 'STI'. The critical gatekeeper residue is Threonine 315 (T315). The agent must find residues within 4 Angstroms of STI and measure the specific distance from T315 to the STI molecule. The final outputs must be a PNG image and a TXT report in the ~/PyMOL_Data directory tree.
